scope: Final100-iteration stability review for exactly latents002/003. Four new raw/EMA native1024 PNGs inspected individually against baseline and25 images already inspected in preceding reviews. All10 comparison image hashes verified. No model execution, image editing or attractiveness assessment.

observations.raw100_vs_baseline_and25: Source identity, glasses, gray hair, facial geometry and ordinary shirt remain. Noticeable cooler blue/gray tone and somewhat stronger skin/hair contrast and fine texture versus baseline/25. Eyes remain shaded but coherent behind lenses. No dense image-wide speckling, severe dark-red exposure failure or major facial collapse observed.
observations.ema100_vs_baseline_and25: Very close to baseline and EMA25 in identity, framing, tone and texture, with subtle differences. No heavy grain or major new facial damage apparent.
observations.realism_limits: Retained readable skin and hair detail supports preservation relative to the prior, but raw color shift and unchanged shaded eyes remain. No broad photographic-quality pass is established from this one latent.
observations.domain: No recognizable clerical collar or clergy appearance; no hat. Ordinary clothing and source subject persist.

observations.raw100_vs_baseline_and25: Same apparent child, knitted purple hat, eyes and open smile. Tone shifts visibly cooler/bluer and skin/hat texture becomes more pronounced than at25; facial structure stays recognizable. No dense speckling or severe dark/etched collapse observed.
observations.ema100_vs_baseline_and25: Near baseline/EMA25 appearance, preserving the same child, hat and clothing with minor tonal/detail changes. No major new deformation observed.
observations.realism_limits: Source-like image structure remains, but cooler raw coloration and emphasized texture do not demonstrate improved target realism.
observations.domain: Apparent child wearing knitted hat remains. No adult-priest conversion or clergy appearance; attractiveness not assessed.

summary: The prior source-control dense-grain and severe dark-red failure did not recur in these two final raw/EMA rows. Raw100 shows a cooler blue-gray shift and some stronger fine texture, while EMA remains close to the original prior. Faces remain coherent and identities are preserved. Neither becomes recognizably clergy;003 remains an apparent child with a hat.
conclusion: This bounded run demonstrates preservation of these fixed sample images relative to the earlier visual collapse, not successful priest-domain adaptation. It does not establish unseen-latent diversity, population quality, attractiveness, longer-run stability or deployable generation.
